examples.text: Environmental DNA analysis suggests that the number of species of bacteria that remain nameless to date may well be on the order of many thousands.

glosses: Whose name is unknown; unidentified or obscured.

examples.text: The culprits shall remain nameless here, as some names have been changed to protect the guilty; just don't let it happen again.
Victims of rug pulls are often left with little recourse against nameless thieves.

glosses: Unable to be described or expressed.

examples.text: a nameless unease

Minute grew into minute, and still there was no sign of life, nor did the curtain move; but I felt the gaze of the unknown being sinking through and through me, and filling me with a nameless terror, till the perspiration stood in beads upon my brow.

glosses: D’une telle importance que cela dépasse toute qualification.

examples.text: La grande majorité des spectateurs adulait Marcel Cerdan et voir le champion du monde tenir en une telle estime un jeune Beyrouthin leur procurait une fierté sans nom.
